newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: A kiss is just a kiss? Not in Geneva.
newsitem.headline: A kiss is just a kiss? Not in Geneva.

text.p: A seven-tonne white marble sculpture of a naked couple kissing has been removed from the heart of Geneva after the city said it did not want to become a dumping ground for unauthorised works of art.

Swiss sculptor Vincent Kesselring removed the "kiss" from an embankment on the shores of Lake Geneva on Tuesday after a court dismissed his appeal for the international city to keep it as a present, Swiss media reported on Wednesday.
The sculptor had erected the "kiss" in 1995 without permission from city officials, who refused to keep it fearing Geneva's lakeside would become a dump for unauthorised works of art.
